$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/quality.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office (and the worker and scheduler, in the tenant's system context) records final inspections, signs quality releases, keeps garment serials and the PPE register through apps/factory-api's modules (B-W1-43, B-W1-44, B-W1-45), always through command(); the API keeps staff to the companies and sites their grants reach. The floor (factory_floor_runtime) works on its OWN site only (every table here but the register has a site key): it reads the site's inspections, defects, releases and serials, records a final inspection with its defects and decides it (a floor inspector, signed in: the …_quality_shipping_guards triggers refuse a floor inspection that names an office user), and gives serials at the final operation (and packs or voids them); it never releases goods. No table here has a cost, price, margin or wages column. Portal and link sessions read nothing here. QualityRelease is append-only (`@append-only`; the triggers refuse UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE for every login): no role updates or deletes it. Nobody deletes an inspection (cancelled), a serial (voided) or a register entry (closed); defects are removed only while their inspection is OPEN. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

Inspection.about: The office (a quality inspector) or the site's floor (a floor inspector, signed in) opens a final inspection of a work order, records its sample and checklist, and decides it (PASSED or FAILED, then frozen) or cancels it; both read the site's inspections.

InspectionDefect.about: The inspector (office or the site's floor) records, corrects and removes the defects of an OPEN inspection; both read the site's defects.

QualityRelease.about: The office signs a release of inspected garments (QHS-058). The floor reads its site's releases (packing ships released garments only, and the packing triggers read them). Nobody changes or removes a release.

GarmentSerial.about: The site's floor gives a serial to each garment of a serial-tracked style at the final operation (B-W1-44), packs it into a shipment line and voids a spoilt one; the office does the same, and releases serials (MADE → RELEASED) and ships them (→ SHIPPED). Nobody deletes a serial.

PpeRegisterEntry.about: The office keeps the PPE register (B-W1-43): it records a complaint, a non-conformity or a recall, the investigation and the action taken, and closes the entry. Office only; nobody deletes an entry.
